provenance_warning: These three signals differ in kind. field is measured, demo is a constructed scenario from real laboratory segments, and twin is fully generated. They should not be treated as equivalent to the laboratory recordings or to each other.

field.provenance: Real field measurement from an industrial fan at Borcelik, FNDE measurement point, same sensor type as the laboratory recordings. The fan operated at variable speed and no rotational-speed signal was recorded, so the RMS level reflects both degradation and speed variation. Shared with the permission of Borcelik.
field.note: Event 2 was reserved as the held-out validation event in the thesis.

demo.provenance: Designed fault progression constructed by arranging real laboratory-rig measurement segments into a degradation path. Used as the demonstration record, the controlled evaluation environment of the forecasting comparison in the thesis.

twin.provenance: Generated by the digital-twin pipeline for the unbalance mechanism: a designed ISO-band trajectory (rms_target) with the hierarchical T1 noise model. The shared Value column is the noisy rms_signal, not the clean rms_target.
